cases.name: modes
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_FMOD() BEGIN HFormat:=0; HDigits:=4; HSeparator:=0; LOCAL out:={},vals:={1.2345,12345.6789,π,0.333333333333,0.123456789012,0.0000123456789},precs:={0,3,12},i,j,m,r; FOR i FROM 1 TO 6 DO FOR m FROM 7 TO 20 DO FOR j FROM 1 TO 3 DO IFERR r:=STRING(vals(i),m,precs(j)); THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{{i,m,precs(j),r}}); END; END; END; Notes("ZZT_FMODS"):=STRING(out); RETURN 0; END;
